exact_items: Keep `active_subview`, filters, compare targets, pinned selections, and similar fields in destination/view-state contracts.
Let routes optionally name a destination-local subview only when that is necessary for the task, but treat it as destination refinement, not base identity.
Reuse persisted project/surface state when the route does not specify a destination-local override.
The route model should be able to land a user in Source Control without becoming a full serialized `source_control.project_state`.
notes: storage-plan.md owns active_subview and panel-local state. These must NOT enter route_target. Route activation can specify destination-local subview only as an override when strictly necessary.

exact_items: route activation overrides remembered state only when required to satisfy the requested destination/object/context; otherwise it should reuse persisted shell state and local destination defaults

MUST override: target object identity; destination surface when the action explicitly names a different surface; scope required to make the target meaningful (project_id, thread_id, focused_run_id, or an explicitly requested panel/tab)
MUST NOT reuse persisted state when doing so would: land on the wrong object; hide the requested target behind the wrong tab/subview; silently keep the user on a stale run/thread/project context
Add a shared route-activation override rule in the contract/GUI owner docs.
notes: No general override rule exists across routing consumers. Without this rule, implementers could legitimately choose either 'always restore old shell state' or 'always hard-reset the destination.' The override rule must be added to Contracts_V0 and FinalGUISpec.

exact_items: `Decision_Log.md` is functionally empty for the rewrite era and does not capture major accepted design decisions already present in working memory and downstream addenda.
notes: Decision_Log.md is empty for the rewrite era. Major decisions are being made only in downstream addenda. The log must be populated with accepted design decisions from the rewrite work.

exact_items: `rewrite-tie-in-memo.md` is itself now stale as a rewrite-alignment owner because it predates seams/packages/lanes/overseers, scopes requested/effective identity too narrowly, and does not surface projection-trust or lane scheduling as rewrite invariants.
notes: rewrite-tie-in-memo.md is a stale rewrite root. It must be updated to: (1) include seams/packages/lanes/overseers, (2) broaden requested/effective identity scope, (3) surface projection-trust and lane scheduling as rewrite invariants.

notes: feature-list.md and newfeatures.md are active misleaders for implementation readers. They contain tier-era framing and stale widget/shell assumptions. These docs need comprehensive updates to reflect rewrite model.

notes: Formatters_System.md has four distinct issues: (1) LSP formatting ownership conflict, (2) under-specified DAE behavior for formatters, (3) custom formatter subprocess can bypass FileSafe/tool policy, (4) format.* events not registered in Contracts_V0.
